emergency: urgent repair needed at a rental
tenant without power or hot water

extra_prompt: You are booking for a real estate agency. Ask whether it is a sale, purchase, or rental matter. For sales, ask about the property, timeline, and reason for selling. For rentals, ask about the property, current tenancy, and management needs. Quote fees only from the reference answers, and say final fees are confirmed in the agency agreement. Do not give legal advice or promise a sale price.

kb.a: {price_note} Commission is confirmed in the agency agreement after appraisal. We do not quote a fee until we have seen the property and discussed your goals.
{appraisal_note} We confirm what the appraisal includes before you book it.
Yes, we run auction and private treaty campaigns. We explain both options so you can choose the one that suits the property and your timeline.
{management_note} Management fees are a percentage of rent plus letting fees, and the exact figures are set out in your management agreement.
Yes, our tenant finding includes advertising, screening and reference checks. We confirm the tenant selection steps when we set up your management agreement.
Routine inspections are usually every three to six months. The schedule is confirmed in your management agreement.
Yes, we coordinate repairs and maintenance with your approval. We will ask before spending above any limit set in your agreement.
Yes, we can carry out market rent reviews. We confirm how often they happen when we set up your management agreement.
Yes, we lodge and manage bonds with the bond authority. Bond details are recorded for both the owner and the tenant.
Yes, we handle sales and leasing of commercial property. Commercial matters are quoted separately from residential work.
Yes, we handle acreage and rural sales. Tell us the land size and any key features when you enquire.

kb.q: Do you help first home buyers?
kb.a: Yes, we explain the buying process and tell you about government grants you may be eligible for. We do not give financial or legal advice, so please speak to the right adviser for that.

kb.q: How long does a sale take?
kb.a: Timing depends on the market and the property. We give you an estimated timeframe after the appraisal.
Our agents hold [licence number] and [insurance details]. Ask us for copies before you sign an agency agreement.
Yes, we can represent buyers in a purchase. Our buyer advocacy fee starts from the amount shown on our price list, and the final fee is set out in your agreement.
Agency agreements run for [agreement term] days. The cancellation terms are set out in the agreement before you sign.

compliance.guidance: Accountants providing tax agent services need registration with the Tax Practitioners Board. Legal practice needs a practising certificate. Mortgage brokers need an Australian credit licence (ASIC). Real estate agents need a licence from the state regulator. Verify each licence before relying on it.
